description: Issue #35, part 4V lesson 04-28 (impact analysis against the fixed-form RPG IV legacy system). ONE wrapper job: gate (DBVER 1: JUCHUM has 4 columns and no JUDLV; JU0300/ZA0500/TK0100 are still OBJATTRIBUTE RPG) -> T28RUN MUT recompiles the three programs from QRPGLE112 with CRTBNDRPG over the same names (and builds JUCINQC from solutions/03-09 when absent) -> DSPPGMREF PGM(lib/*ALL), DSPPGMREF PGM(lib/ZA0500), DSPDBR JUCHUM and DSPFD JUCHU* TYPE(*RCDFMT) to QTEMP outfiles in the SAME job, read with RUNSQL into VFY28 (tags A-GATE, B-MUT, C-COLS, D-JUCHUM, E-JUCHUL1, F-ZAIKOM, G-BYPGM, H-DBR, Z-AFTER) and copied with CPYF into VFY28P/Z/D/F for the real column names (ILE specific columns are UNVERIFIED) -> T28RUN RST puts the RPG III programs back with CRTRPGPGM from QRPGSRC, deletes a JUCINQC this batch built, and runs TXRESET -> LAST (hang-prone, after the restore): FNDSTRPDM on QRPGLE112 and QCLSRC (OPTION(*NONE) PRTMBRLIST(*YES) PRTRCDS(*ALL), the proven form; hits are read with qsh grep in the after phase). T28RUN also does RMVLIBLE of <USER>1 (RTVJOBA CURUSER + 1) first, so unqualified file names resolve in the batch library. If the gate fails nothing is changed and the analysis still runs against whatever state the library is in (read the A-GATE rows). A final collect reads QTEMP.PGMREF from another job (expected to fail: QTEMP is job scoped). Nothing in the sample data is changed except by TXRESET, which restores it.

steps.label: CPRSTCMD
steps.cmd:
DLTCMD CMD(&LIB/TXRESET)
MONMSG MSGID(CPF0000)
CRTCMD CMD(&LIB/TXRESET) PGM(&LIB/TXRESET) SRCFILE(&LIB/QCMDSRC) SRCMBR(TXRESET)

steps.label: MK28
steps.cmd: RUNSQL SQL('CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE &LIB/VFY28 (TS TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT TIMESTAMP, TAG VARCHAR(24), K1 VARCHAR(30), K2 VARCHAR(30), V VARCHAR(80))') COMMIT(*NONE)

steps.label: MK28G
steps.cmd: RUNSQL SQL('CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE &LIB/VFY28G (OK CHAR(1))') COMMIT(*NONE)

steps.label: GCOLS
steps.cmd: RUNSQL SQL('INSERT INTO &LIB/VFY28 (TAG, K1, K2, V) SELECT ''A-GATE'', ''JUCHUM-COLS'', '' '', CHAR(COUNT(*)) FROM QSYS2.SYSCOLUMNS WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = ''&LIB'' AND TABLE_NAME = ''JUCHUM''') COMMIT(*NONE)

steps.label: GJUDLV
steps.cmd: RUNSQL SQL('INSERT INTO &LIB/VFY28 (TAG, K1, K2, V) SELECT ''A-GATE'', ''JUDLV-COLS'', '' '', CHAR(COUNT(*)) FROM QSYS2.SYSCOLUMNS WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = ''&LIB'' AND TABLE_NAME = ''JUCHUM'' AND COLUMN_NAME = ''JUDLV''') COMMIT(*NONE)

steps.label: GATTR
steps.cmd: RUNSQL SQL('INSERT INTO &LIB/VFY28 (TAG, K1, K2, V) SELECT ''A-BEFORE'', OBJNAME, OBJTYPE, OBJATTRIBUTE FROM TABLE(QSYS2.OBJECT_STATISTICS(''&LIB'', ''*PGM'')) X WHERE OBJNAME IN (''JU0300'', ''ZA0500'', ''TK0100'')') COMMIT(*NONE)

steps.label: GOK
steps.cmd: RUNSQL SQL('INSERT INTO &LIB/VFY28G (OK) SELECT ''Y'' FROM SYSIBM.SYSDUMMY1 WHERE (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM QSYS2.SYSCOLUMNS WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = ''&LIB'' AND TABLE_NAME = ''JUCHUM'') = 4 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM QSYS2.SYSCOLUMNS WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = ''&LIB'' AND TABLE_NAME = ''JUCHUM'' AND COLUMN_NAME = ''JUDLV'') = 0 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TABLE(QSYS2.OBJECT_STATISTICS(''&LIB'', ''*PGM'')) X WHERE OBJNAME IN (''JU0300'', ''ZA0500'', ''TK0100'') AND OBJATTRIBUTE = ''RPG'') = 3') COMMIT(*NONE)

steps.label: GOKROW
steps.cmd: RUNSQL SQL('INSERT INTO &LIB/VFY28 (TAG, K1, K2, V) SELECT ''A-GATE'', ''GATE-ROWS'', '' '', CHAR(COUNT(*)) FROM &LIB/VFY28G') COMMIT(*NONE)

steps.label: BATTR
steps.cmd: RUNSQL SQL('INSERT INTO &LIB/VFY28 (TAG, K1, K2, V) SELECT ''B-MUT'', OBJNAME, OBJTYPE, OBJATTRIBUTE FROM TABLE(QSYS2.OBJECT_STATISTICS(''&LIB'', ''*PGM'')) X WHERE OBJNAME IN (''JU0300'', ''ZA0500'', ''TK0100'')') COMMIT(*NONE)

steps.label: BJIC
steps.cmd: RUNSQL SQL('INSERT INTO &LIB/VFY28 (TAG, K1, K2, V) SELECT ''B-MUT'', OBJNAME, OBJTYPE, OBJATTRIBUTE FROM TABLE(QSYS2.OBJECT_STATISTICS(''&LIB'', ''*PGM'')) X WHERE OBJNAME = ''JUCINQC''') COMMIT(*NONE)

steps.label: CCOLS
steps.cmd: RUNSQL SQL('INSERT INTO &LIB/VFY28 (TAG, K1, K2, V) SELECT ''C-COLS'', COLUMN_NAME, DATA_TYPE, CHAR(LENGTH) FROM QSYS2.SYSCOLUMNS WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = ''QTEMP'' AND TABLE_NAME = ''PGMREF'' ORDER BY ORDINAL_POSITION') COMMIT(*NONE)

steps.label: DJUCHUM
steps.cmd: RUNSQL SQL('INSERT INTO &LIB/VFY28 (TAG, K1, K2, V) SELECT ''D-JUCHUM'', WHPNAM, WHFNAM, WHOBJT FROM QTEMP/PGMREF WHERE WHFNAM = ''JUCHUM'' ORDER BY WHPNAM') COMMIT(*NONE)

steps.label: DJUCHUL1
steps.cmd: RUNSQL SQL('INSERT INTO &LIB/VFY28 (TAG, K1, K2, V) SELECT ''E-JUCHUL1'', WHPNAM, WHFNAM, WHOBJT FROM QTEMP/PGMREF WHERE WHFNAM = ''JUCHUL1'' ORDER BY WHPNAM') COMMIT(*NONE)

steps.label: DZAIKOM
steps.cmd: RUNSQL SQL('INSERT INTO &LIB/VFY28 (TAG, K1, K2, V) SELECT ''F-ZAIKOM'', WHPNAM, WHFNAM, WHOBJT FROM QTEMP/PGMREF WHERE WHFNAM = ''ZAIKOM'' ORDER BY WHPNAM') COMMIT(*NONE)

steps.label: DPGMS
steps.cmd: RUNSQL SQL('INSERT INTO &LIB/VFY28 (TAG, K1, K2, V) SELECT ''G-BYPGM'', WHPNAM, WHFNAM, WHOBJT FROM QTEMP/PGMREF WHERE WHPNAM IN (''JU0300'', ''ZA0500'', ''TK0100'', ''JU0900C'', ''JUCINQC'') ORDER BY WHPNAM') COMMIT(*NONE)

steps.label: DDBR
steps.cmd: RUNSQL SQL('INSERT INTO &LIB/VFY28 (TAG, K1, K2, V) SELECT ''H-DBR'', WHRFI, WHREFI, WHTYPE FROM QTEMP/DBRJUCHUM') COMMIT(*NONE)

steps.label: ZATTR
steps.cmd: RUNSQL SQL('INSERT INTO &LIB/VFY28 (TAG, K1, K2, V) SELECT ''Z-AFTER'', OBJNAME, OBJTYPE, OBJATTRIBUTE FROM TABLE(QSYS2.OBJECT_STATISTICS(''&LIB'', ''*PGM'')) X WHERE OBJNAME IN (''JU0300'', ''ZA0500'', ''TK0100'')') COMMIT(*NONE)

steps.label: ZJIC
steps.cmd: RUNSQL SQL('INSERT INTO &LIB/VFY28 (TAG, K1, K2, V) SELECT ''Z-AFTER'', OBJNAME, OBJTYPE, OBJATTRIBUTE FROM TABLE(QSYS2.OBJECT_STATISTICS(''&LIB'', ''*PGM'')) X WHERE OBJNAME = ''JUCINQC''') COMMIT(*NONE)

steps.label: FNDJU
steps.cmd: FNDSTRPDM FILE(&LIB/QRPGLE112) MBR(*ALL) STRING('JUCHUM') OPTION(*NONE) PRTMBRLIST(*YES) PRTRCDS(*ALL)

steps.label: FNDJUC
steps.cmd: FNDSTRPDM FILE(&LIB/QCLSRC) MBR(*ALL) STRING('JUCHUM') OPTION(*NONE) PRTMBRLIST(*YES) PRTRCDS(*ALL)

steps.label: FNDZA
steps.cmd: FNDSTRPDM FILE(&LIB/QRPGLE112) MBR(*ALL) STRING('ZAIKOM') OPTION(*NONE) PRTMBRLIST(*YES) PRTRCDS(*ALL)

steps.label: SPLLIST
steps.cmd: db2 "SELECT SPOOLED_FILE_NAME, JOB_NAME, FILE_NUMBER, TOTAL_PAGES, CREATE_TIMESTAMP FROM QSYS2.OUTPUT_QUEUE_ENTRIES WHERE USER_NAME = CURRENT_USER ORDER BY CREATE_TIMESTAMP DESC FETCH FIRST 12 ROWS ONLY" 2>&1

steps.sql: SELECT TS, TAG, K1, K2, V FROM &LIB/VFY28 ORDER BY TS
SELECT * FROM &LIB/VFY28P WHERE WHPNAM IN ('ZA0500', 'JU0300') FETCH FIRST 24 ROWS ONLY
SELECT * FROM &LIB/VFY28Z FETCH FIRST 12 ROWS ONLY
SELECT * FROM &LIB/VFY28F FETCH FIRST 6 ROWS ONLY
